categoriesPage.description: Categories group your dishes on the menu. Drag to change the order guests see.
categoriesPage.atLimit: You have used every category your plan allows. Delete one to add another.
categoriesPage.emptyDescription: Start with something like Starters, Mains or Drinks. You can rename and reorder them any time.
categoriesPage.deleteDescription: Its dishes are kept and simply lose their category, so you can move them somewhere else.

categoryDialog.nameHint: Needed in your menu's main language; the other one can be added later.
categoryDialog.descriptionHint: One line under the heading on your menu.
categoryDialog.iconHint: Shown before the category in your menu's tabs.

categoryToast.deletedDetail: Its dishes were kept and now have no category.

categorySchema.nameRequired: A category name is required in {{language}}.

dishesPage.description: Everything guests can order. Drag to change the order they appear in.
dishesPage.atLimit: You have used every dish your plan allows. Delete one to add another.
dishesPage.noCategoriesDescription: Every dish belongs to a category, so your menu has some structure before you start filling it.
dishesPage.orphansDescription: Their category was deleted. Add a category, then edit each dish to move it there.
dishesPage.emptyDescription: Add your first dish with a name, a price and a photo.
dishesPage.emptyFilteredDescription: Add a dish here, or pick another category above.
dishesPage.deleteDescription: This removes the dish and its photo from your menu. It cannot be undone.
dishesPage.deleteDeal: It is the deal of “{{title}}”; the offer stays, without a deal.

deal.off: Hidden: your package keeps “{{title}}” off the menu

dishDialog.needsCategory: Every dish belongs to a category.
dishDialog.priceHint: Leave empty to hide the price.
dishDialog.priceHintFromVariant: No dish price: each {{variant}} sets the full price.
dishDialog.priceHintWithVariant: Variant prices are added to this. Leave it empty to price by {{variant}} alone.
dishDialog.photoHint: We trim it to fit the dish card and make it quick to load.
dishDialog.availableDescription: Turn this off when it runs out: guests stop seeing it until you turn it back on. Nothing is deleted.
dishDialog.priceHintFromBuild: No dish price: the guest's build sets the price.

dishDialog.builtByGuests: Guests build this dish. Edit how in Build your own.
dishDialog.deal: Made by the offer “{{title}}”. It shows on your menu only while the offer is running.
